newsitem.title: FINLAND: MERITA REVERSES LOSS, HEADS UP AFTER H1.
newsitem.headline: MERITA REVERSES LOSS, HEADS UP AFTER H1.

text.p: Shares in Merita Oy, Finland's largest financial group, reversed earlier losses on Wednesday to trade ahead as markets turned brighter and after its H1 report came in at the top end of expectations, brokers said.
At 1615/1315 GMT, Merita was up 0.40 markka or almost two percent at 23.10 markka. It had been rising and settled after an in-house deal of 2.5 million shares by AG Private Bankers at 22.60 markka.
Several analysts said they expected to hike earnings forecasts after Merita H1 profit surged to 1.81 billion markka.
But brokers said the stock direction depended heavily on U.S. treasuries.
